name: Antler India
identity_check: Antler India: the India arm of Antler (antler.co), with its own location page (antler.co/location/india), a Bengaluru office, an India AI Residency, its own team (Partners Rajiv Srivatsa and Nitin Sharma, called co-founders and General Partners in the Sep 2023 release) and a domestic maiden fund that Inc42 says operates separately from Antler's Singapore-based global entity. Confirmed by the antler.co India page and press release, and by Entrackr/Inc42 coverage naming 'Antler India'. Only India funds, people, terms and deals are recorded; the global parent is the separate record 'antler'. Not Antler Elevate (Antler's later-stage fund, which co-invested in InspeCity alongside Antler India), not Antler US, and not unrelated 'Antler' companies.

thesis_text.value: Bengaluru-based India arm of Antler backing AI-first founders from pre-product to first institutional cheque, via its AI Residency or directly (about half of deals). Standard deal is about INR 4 Cr for 11%, with decisions in roughly three weeks. Its Embark programme moves India-based AI founders to San Francisco for US traction, leading a ~$450K pre-seed cheque.

open_items: No explicit statement on whether Antler India invests in US-domiciled (flipped) companies. requires_us_entity = 'no' rests on the India Residency (in person in Bengaluru), the domestic India fund (Inc42: operates separately from Antler's Singapore global entity) and Indian Pvt Ltd portfolio companies (Navana Tech India Private Limited; Green Aero Propulsion Private Limited). Embark (quoted by Nitin Sharma, Partner, Antler India) takes India-based AI founders to San Francisco and its partners help with US incorporation, so flipped companies are supported there; which Antler vehicle writes the Embark cheque is not stated.

Instrument not stated: the India page says '11% equity' and 'Founder-friendly terms designed to support future rounds'; no SAFE / CCPS / convertible detail found. Residency investment rate is given as both '60%+' and '50-75% of the teams'.

Maiden fund (INR 600 Cr target) final close not confirmed and no second India fund found; fund legal name and SEBI AIF category not stated. Inc42 (Feb 2025) quotes Nitin Sharma calling it the largest first fund within Antler globally, with 150+ LPs.

Rounds where the article names only 'Antler', not 'Antler India': Aignosis (Jaipur), CraftifAI (Bengaluru), Green Aero (Delhi) and Dodo Payments. Green Aero and Dodo Payments are listed on the Antler India page; Aignosis and CraftifAI are Indian companies but the Antler entity is not confirmed.

IndustrialMind.ai (AI engineer for manufacturing: drawings to process plans and cost estimates, line monitoring, root cause; ex-Tesla founders; $1.2M pre-seed with Antler, TSVC, Plug and Play, Nov 2025) is one of the Embark founder stories, but no source ties it to Antler India; not recorded as a round. Worth a competitor check (overlaps engineering-drawing / process-planning / plant-ops layers).
No round article found for Antler India portfolio companies Dodge.ai (Embark), Aspera Industries, Armory, Autodraft AI, Freshcon, HouseEazy and BazaarNow.

Navana.ai pre-Series A (reportedly Jul 2025, Rs 7 Cr, led by Antler India) seen only in a search-result summary of a tracker; not opened. InspeCity's May 2025 seed (Rs 46 Cr led by Ashish Kacholia, Antler India participating) is described only inside the Aug 2026 article; not recorded separately.

Not recorded (role or entity unclear, or no dedicated article read): UniqYou seed (Sep 2026, Rs 15.8 Cr, led by Arkam Ventures and Antler; Entrackr weekly report only), ProLearn pre-seed ($3.2M, BeeNext lead, Antler India participating; search summary only), Mandrake Bio pre-seed (Jul 2026, Rs 16 Cr, co-led by Activate and 'Antler'; HQ not stated).

YourStory pages returned 403, including 'Antler is doubling its checks and speed amidst the flurry of AI companies in India' (Jan 2026) and the Jul 2026 cohort piece; any cheque-size or fund updates there were not read. Economic Times is not reachable from this agent.
Timing: the next India AI Residency is 'to be announced'; Embark 4 starts October 2026 (application deadline 31 Aug 2026 has passed); Embark runs twice a year (May and October).
No Antler India LinkedIn company page is linked from the India page; not recorded. Partner focus sectors for Rajiv Srivatsa and Nitin Sharma are not stated on the India page.
